// HANDS.md hand 36's pair: the same twelve cards with every land a Forest.
//
// Loam is cast exactly as it is in hand-36.txt -- one green source is all it
// needs -- but {2}{U} is never there, so Spellseeker is never cast and the
// tutor never fires. Its numbers are hand-36.txt's with the tutor undeclared,
// which is what says the fetch fires on the casting and not on the holding.
10x Forest [Land]
1x Spellseeker [Tutor]
1x Life from the Loam [Engine]
